description: Declared public names that were deliberately retired from src/, domain/ and scripts/. Append-only: an entry is never deleted, because the gate reads this file to explain every name that disappeared between two revisions. The one exception is a "*" entry whose module has come back -- it is then false, and the gate only lets it be dropped, never rewritten. See docs/GUARDRAILS.md section B.

retirements.name: write_model_config_update
retirements.reason: Model publication moved to src.application.config_features.write_model_config_update so the profile resolver used by config generation no longer imports its own publisher. Human bot/assistant model add/use commands retain their contract; Python callers must import the authoring owner.

retirements.name: upsert_note_kv
retirements.reason: Note-key/value upsert retired with the note-as-fact path: exp/multiplier are no longer written into note, because facts live in structured keys; merge_note is the surviving note writer.

retirements.name: STRICT_MIN_DTE
retirements.reason: The fixed 14-day minimum was retired when Close Advice switched to remaining annualized return with a positive DTE requirement.

retirements.name: STRICT_MIN_REMAINING_TERM_RATIO
retirements.reason: The first-half-of-contract gate was retired because opening term no longer determines the remaining yield decision.

retirements.name: STRICT_MAX_CLOSE_COST_TO_STRIKE_RATIO
retirements.reason: The strike-notional close-cost ceiling was replaced by the Put or Call capital-basis remaining annualized return calculation.

retirements.name: STRICT_MAX_SPREAD_RATIO
retirements.reason: The spread percentage ceiling was retired; a valid two-sided quote is now evaluated at its ask price with fees.

retirements.name: MAX_LOG_FILE_BYTES
retirements.reason: Whole-file rejection was retired because runtime logs now read only a bounded tail regardless of file size.

retirements.name: compare_runtime_portfolio_snapshot
retirements.reason: The five-section comparison used compact snapshot facts on both sides and could not establish independent legacy equality. New v2 artifacts retain only the sourced ledger_shadow status; historical v1 artifacts remain read-only.

retirements.name: load_candidate_snapshot_bundle_readonly
retirements.reason: The broad readonly loader was retired because current runtime reads now require the v4 manifest and retired bundles are available only through the explicit candidate_evidence_history inspection and replay boundary.

retirements.name: load_candidate_snapshot_bundle_v3
retirements.reason: Manifest v3 is retired from current candidate reads; sealed v3 evidence remains readable only through candidate_evidence_history as limited, non-contributing history.

retirements.name: load_latest_candidate_snapshot_bundle_readonly
retirements.reason: Latest-run discovery no longer performs broad legacy fallback; current discovery requires the v4 contract while explicit historical inspection owns retired bundle selection.

retirements.name: publish_candidate_snapshot_manifest_v3
retirements.reason: New candidate runs publish only manifest v4 through publish_candidate_snapshot_manifest; manifest v3 remains an immutable historical format and has no writer.

retirements.name: seal_experience_candidate_bundle
retirements.reason: The standalone Experience manifest v2 writer was retired; Experience owner snapshots use the shared current owner schemas and terminate through the current manifest v4 publisher.

retirements.name: publish_strategy_scan_status_index_v2
retirements.reason: Status index v2 is a sealed historical format and no longer has a writer; current runs publish index v5 and explicit history adapters validate archived v2 evidence.

retirements.name: publish_strategy_scan_status_index_v4
retirements.reason: Status index v4 is a sealed historical format and no longer has a writer; current runs publish index v5 and explicit history adapters validate archived v4 evidence.

retirements.name: CLOSE_ADVICE_TOOL

retirements.name: GET_CLOSE_ADVICE_TOOL
retirements.reason: The one-shot Agent refresh-and-generate entry was retired because it bypassed the sealed scheduled snapshot boundary; close_advice_read is the surviving Agent surface.

retirements.name: PREPARE_CLOSE_ADVICE_INPUTS_TOOL
retirements.reason: The Agent-owned mutable input preparation entry was retired because required-data planning and sealing belong to the scheduled Tick path.

retirements.name: close_advice_rows_summary
retirements.reason: The generator-only Close Advice summary helper was retired with the mutable Agent generation workflow; read projection now belongs to close_advice_read.

retirements.name: close_advice_tool
retirements.reason: The mutable Agent Close Advice implementation was retired so the scheduled sealed runner is the sole report producer.

retirements.name: get_close_advice_tool
retirements.reason: The one-shot mutable Agent implementation was retired because it refreshed data outside the sealed scheduled run.

retirements.name: prepare_close_advice_inputs_tool
retirements.reason: The mutable Agent input preparation implementation was retired because Tick owns required-data acquisition, planning, and sealing.
The compatibility pipeline that forwarded to the retired get_close_advice tool was deleted; callers use close_advice_read for existing sealed reports.

retirements.name: load_config

retirements.name: load_required_data_coverage
retirements.reason: Mutable required-data cache coverage loading was retired because Close Advice now accepts only manifest-bound sealed CSV bytes.

retirements.name: load_required_data_quotes
retirements.reason: Mutable required-data cache quote loading was retired because Close Advice now accepts only manifest-bound sealed CSV bytes.

retirements.name: run_from_paths
retirements.reason: The unsealed convenience runner was retired because every Close Advice execution now requires an explicit run, snapshot manifest, and bound plan.
